page.content:
Hell that forges specters and fallen emperors.

How Netherrealm connects

  • Character: Scorpion — Scorpion was remade in the Netherrealm after the clan massacre.
  • Topic: Mortal Kombat — The Netherrealm is the hell that forges specters in Mortal Kombat.

What is Netherrealm?

The Netherrealm is Mortal Kombat's hell: the prison of fallen gods and the fire that remade Hanzo Hasashi into Scorpion.

Key threads lead to Scorpion and Mortal Kombat.
